history.sg_progress: The Administration will create a database with the rates of reimbursement made in previous cases of ammunition and explosives claims. On the basis of the data collected, the Administration will submit an issue paper to the 2023 gathering of the Working Group on Contingent-Owned Equipment for its consideration. Once a decision has been made in the Working Group and endorsed by the General Assembly, the database price will be used as a benchmark for future claims.
